# admission: every directive kind (attempt 1's VM: cloned and stopped, not yet cloned for the clone) against each condition, received in a fresh session: the receipt.
# no_room: a host with nothing (mutant 24: refused whatever the control plane allocated); other_host: the VM or proof names host9; foreign_proof: the proof names attempt 2's VM (delete) or generation 2 (stop) for attempt 1's directive; a condition that does not apply to a kind leaves it as normal.
pull_image x normal -> execute
pull_image x safe -> reply e5 refused safe_mode
pull_image x expired -> reply e5 refused deadline_expired
pull_image x no_room -> reply e5 refused insufficient_resources(disk)
pull_image x other_host -> execute
pull_image x foreign_proof -> execute
pull_image x bad_runner_version -> execute
materialise_image x normal -> execute

materialise_image x bad_runner_version -> reply e5 refused effect_failed
